question: The profit percentage made on an item sold for Rs.1,920 is equal to the loss percentage made on selling the same item for Rs.1,280. What should the item be sold for in order to make a 25% profit?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the profit percentage equals the loss percentage on an item, the Cost Price (CP) is the exact average of the two selling prices.

CP = (1920 + 1280) ÷ 2 = 3200 ÷ 2 = Rs.1,600

Required SP for 25% profit = CP × 1.25

SP = 1600 × (125 ÷ 100) = 1600 × (5 ÷ 4) = Rs.2,000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.2,000.**
